description:
Search Bill Commons' bounded, source-labelled frontier-AI policy registry.

    This is not a comprehensive global or federal legislative database. It
    returns only the curated records currently held by the registry, including
    its coverage statement and retrieval timestamps. Use `jurisdiction`,
    `instrument_type`, `status`, or an exact topic; use `q` for a title,
    summary, or topic substring. `since` filters source publication dates and
    `changed_since` filters source-check activity on or after an ISO date;
    a retrieval or changed source body does not establish a policy change.
name: search_policy_developments
